item.title: How Pickle’s Brian McMahon and Julia O’Mara Are Building the Airbnb of Clothing
item.description: Pickle founders Brian McMahon and Julia O’Mara discuss building their peer-to-peer clothing rental app and turning Gen Z closets into a marketplace.

item.title: Inside the Global Art Fair Wars
item.description: Art Basel changes cities, Frieze joins them and the rest observe from the regional margins.

item.title: A.I. Adoption Without Literacy Is a Governance Risk
item.description: Trilateral Research’s Amelia Williams unpacks the governance risks emerging from rapid enterprise A.I. adoption, arguing that the debate has focused too narrowly on regulation and technical controls while overlooking workforce capability. As frameworks formalize literacy requirements, responsible A.I. governance must be built through employee investment as much as policy compliance.

item.title: London Saw Few Auction Shakeups as Guarantees Steadied the Market
item.description: Auction houses have become remarkably adept at preserving market confidence through meticulously calibrated scripts and prearranged deals, even as the world beyond the saleroom seems to be steadily coming apart.

item.title: One Fine Show: “Ann Hamilton, still and moving • the tactile image” at the Cleveland Museum of Art
item.description: Using light and texture, she transforms archival museum objects into enigmatic visual presences that feel both ancient and newly discovered.

item.title: Ambassadors Clubhouse Brings Punjabi Fine Dining to New York
item.description: The buzzy NoMad opening from London's JKS Restaurants arrives with a 50,000-person waitlist, lavish interiors and an opulent Punjabi menu.

item.title: Costco CEO Ron Vachris Pledges to Return Tariff Refunds to Shoppers
item.description: Ron Vachris reinforces Costco’s low-price legacy, promising to return tariff refunds and strengthen the retailer’s bond with loyal members.

item.title: Chris Kempczinski’s Viral Burger Bite Shows the Limits of CEO Authenticity
item.description: A viral Big Arch Burger clip puts McDonald’s CEO Chris Kempczinski at the center of a debate over whether corporate leaders should perform authenticity on social media.

item.title: Vacheron Constantin Borrows the Luxury Concours d’ Elegance Concept from the Auto World
item.description: Collectors submit their timepieces knowing that the only prize is the prestige of the win and the acknowledgment that a watch represents the apex of its era.

item.title: The 2026 Whitney Biennial Delivers American Art for a Fractured Age
item.description: Across the Biennial, artists trace the afterlives of empire, technological distortion and ecological collapse—theirs is a world struggling to imagine the conditions of its own renewal.
